correctness.rationale: Use φ(ψ(n))/n=[φ(ψ(n))/ψ(n)]∏_{p|n}(1+1/p). If n even but not 2, 6|ψ(n), so first factor≤1/3, and five-prime product≤(3/2)(4/3)(6/5)(8/7)(12/11)=1152/385<3. If n odd, 2|ψ(n); if 5∤n the product≤(4/3)(8/7)(12/11)(14/13)(18/17)=4608/2431<2. If 5|n, 6|ψ(n) and product≤(4/3)(6/5)(8/7)(12/11)(14/13)=1536/715<3. These exhaustive cases yield strictness except n=2; n=2 gives equality. Independently factored n=39270=2·3·5·7·11·17, ψ=124416 and φ(ψ)=41472>39270. Bounds apply to arbitrary prime exponents; source finite sieve through 200000 is not the proof.
